# Karan Veer Singh Sikarwar

> Personal index, biography, engineering showcase, and links for Karan Veer Singh Sikarwar, spanning computer science, finance, economics, and automobiles.

## Core Pages
- [Personal Index](https://karanveersingh05.github.io/links.to.me/): Primary landing page and directory of profiles, writing, and business links.
- [About](https://karanveersingh05.github.io/links.to.me/about/): Personal story from Sohar (Oman) to Patna, Kota, and Jaipur, alongside interests in technology, finance, and motorcycling.
- [Engineering Showcase](https://karanveersingh05.github.io/links.to.me/gitcode/): Selected software, data engineering, security, and machine learning projects.

## Selected Engineering Projects
- [Cybersecurity Companion](https://karanveersingh05.github.io/cybersecurity-Companion-/): Desktop companion for exploring cybersecurity concepts and practical security awareness.
- [Mutual Funds Analytics](https://karanveersingh05.github.io/MutualFundsAnalytics/): Finance-focused data analytics project exploring mutual fund information.
- [All India Village Dataset API](https://karanveersingh05.github.io/All-India-Village-Dataset-API/): Large-scale open data API for India's village-level dataset.
- [Nifty 100 Fundamental Intelligence](https://karanveersingh05.github.io/Nifty-100-Fundamental-Intelligence/): Data engineering, fundamental analysis, and automated health-scoring platform for Nifty 100 companies.
- [Media Recommendation System](https://karanveersingh05.github.io/Media-Recemmondation-System/): Machine learning project exploring media recommendation generation.
